lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are distributed across the mid-lateral flank, forming a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at near-right angles, creating distinct high-intensity nodes within a lattice-like structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a strong vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing surface and shadow on the ventral-facing surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark, elongated silhouettes (remoras) are visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral and posterior regions of the pectoral fin.
